accepted.sentence: In watch repair, a precision-sized tip turns tiny case fasteners without disturbing nearby delicate components.
When replacing a faucet handle, loosening its concealed retaining fastener allows the handle to lift from the valve stem.
During camera repair, removing casing fasteners opens joined panels for internal cleaning or component replacement.
Installers turn fasteners through solar-panel clamps into support rails, securing each module in place.
At a sewing-machine service bench, removing cover fasteners provides access for lint removal and mechanism maintenance.
To secure a fire-extinguisher bracket, installers turn fasteners into anchors embedded in masonry.
Tightening the fasteners joining skateboard trucks to the deck helps keep the assembly stable during use.
During a drone repair, removing small housing fasteners lets technicians reach the flight-control components inside.
